shared_elements: human or humanoid figures in profile with raised/outstretched arms
figures arranged in a horizontal frieze on a single register
figures oriented toward a central element/action
low relief carving of bodies with arms extended forward
justification: Both show a horizontal frieze of profile figures with arms extended toward a centre, and in B the winged attendants flank a central stylised tree while in A figures converge on a central animal or seated form, giving a loosely comparable antithetical grouping. However, the specific content differs greatly: B has elaborate winged, bearded, richly patterned genii, a highly ornamental palmette-and-volute tree and a dense inscription band, whereas A shows plain, unadorned, roughly modelled nude figures with no wings, plants or writing, in a far more schematic and crude manner.
